title: Understanding Overfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too well, capturing noise and fluctuations that do not generalize to new data. This often results in high variance.

title: Strategies to Reduce Variance
text: To reduce variance, consider simplifying the model, using regularization techniques, or increasing the amount of training data.

title: Regularization Techniques
text: Regularization techniques like L1 (Lasso) and L2 (Ridge) add a penalty to the loss function to discourage overly complex models.

title: Adding New Features
text: Adding new features can sometimes increase model complexity and variance. Consider whether the new features are relevant and necessary.
